text:
Maya S: Hey team, Acme (Dedicated) hit us — dashboard legend colors don't match series and tooltips show raw model IDs instead of names on mobile. Also customer reports missing points for a ~10m window around 13:20 UTC. Ticket INF-4821. Screenshot + short video attached. :rotating_light:

Nia (support): Escalating to eng-frontend + infra. Customer says this started after today's analytics deploy (~13:05 UTC). They've asked for ETA. I'm adding logs and UA string.

Samir K: Thanks. Can you paste the user-agent and any error ids? Also any API 502/5xx times?

Maya S: UA: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 15_6 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Mobile/15E148. Customer saw 502s to /v1/metrics at 13:22:17 UTC. Screenshot: https://redwood-prod.s3/attachments/inf-4821/clip.mov

deploy-bot: production deploy 2026-11-02T13:05Z - analytics-service v2.4.9 (sha: b3f7a1c)

Ben (eng-frontend): I can repro on a mobile width (375x667) in Simulator. Legend items are wrapping into the hamburger and overlapping. Tooltip content shows `model_id: m_ae12f` instead of friendly name — looks like the mapping layer isn't applied in the tooltip path. Quick inspection: frontend is now reading `model_label` field to populate tooltip, but backend event uses `friendly_name` in the timeseries payload. If model_label empty -> fallback shows id.

Samir K: On infra side, metrics-ingest shows backpressure spikes 13:18-13:28; redis pubsub latency spiked and a bunch of batches were delayed. That could explain the missing points. I also see a handful of 502s correlated with a short retry storm from the analytics proxy.

Olivia T: Confirming: aggregation service PR changed the output key from `model_name` -> `model_label` during refactor. Downstream consumers (frontend) were updated, but some backfilled or older events still lack model_label, so tooltip falls back to id. This is a mapping mismatch, not purely CSS.

Maya S: Customer is asking for a hotfix — they are on a committed Dedicated plan. Can we 1) restore tooltip mapping fallback to friendly_name, 2) fix mobile legend wrapping, and 3) backfill missing datapoints?

Ben (eng-frontend): Plan: quick front-end hotfix to use `friendly_name || model_label || id` in tooltip and add CSS guard for legend items to prevent wrap. Will cut a canary ASAP. Repro steps for us:
1) Open Console -> Model usage dashboard on mobile width 375x667
2) Time range last 1h
3) Tap legend item to see tooltip (or long-press on touch simulator)
4) Observe tooltip shows id (bad) and legend items overlap/hamburger (bad)

Snippet of proposed CSS fix:
```css
.legend-item { min-width: 48px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.legend { gap: 8px; }
```

Samir K: I'm going to coordinate infra: scaling redis and restarting a couple of workers to clear backpressure. Also kicking off the backfill job for the missing 10m window. infra-bot will post progress.

infra-bot: started redis scale + worker restart at 2026-11-02T14:10Z. Backfill job queued (job id bf-17935).

Ben (eng-frontend): Pushed hotfix branch and opened PR #3245 (frontend). Canary deploy request sent.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started 2026-11-02T15:10Z - frontend v1.12.3-hotfix (sha: d9c2f7b)

Ben (eng-frontend): Canary passed basic smoke tests, rolling to prod now. Changes: tooltip fallback + legend CSS. No DB migrations.

Maya S: Notified customer about ETA (approx 2-3h). They're watching for the legend/tooltip fix first.

deploy-bot: prod deploy completed 2026-11-02T15:28Z - frontend v1.12.3-hotfix

Nia (support): Customer confirmed after 15:40 UTC that legend colors are aligned and tooltip shows friendly names. They still see one missing datapoint at 13:23. Asking if that will be recovered.

Samir K: infra: backfill bf-17935 started, estimated completion 18:00 UTC. Scale/stabilize steps completed. We'll monitor for any further 5xxs.

Olivia T: Filing analytics-e2e task to assert tooltip text precedence and mobile legend layout to prevent regressions.

Maya S: Great — setting the ticket to monitoring. Will close after backfill completes and customer confirms. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Ben (eng-frontend): Follow-up todos: add a defensive transform in aggregation service to always populate both `friendly_name` and `model_label` for new events, and add unit tests for mapping.

Maya S: Copy that. I'll update INF-4821 with notes and next steps.

(END THREAD)
